claims.claim_text: On May 23, 2023 the DOE declined to award the previously-announced $200 million grant to Microvast for a polyaramid separator manufacturing facility in Hopkinsville, Kentucky (originally announced October 2022 in collaboration with General Motors).
claims.source_quote: In October 2022, we were notified by the U.S. Department of Energy ( DOE ) that we had been selected, in collaboration with General Motors, to receive $200 million in grant funding as part of the DOE's Battery Materials Processing and Battery Manufacturing initiative... On May 23, 2023 the DOE announced that it was declining to award the previously-announced $200 million grant to us.

claims.extraction_notes: If the grant had been awarded it would have shown up in USAspending federal financial-assistance data. Absence of any large DOE Battery Materials grant to Microvast corroborates the rescission claim. Also worth a cross-check via edgar_fts on GM 10-K for any mention.

The financial statements themselves are internal so the underlying numbers are not externally falsifiable, but the market response to the distress claim is observable through securities-lending.

proposed_connector.name: sec_xbrl.financial_concept_timeseries
proposed_connector.description: SEC EDGAR XBRL company-concept facts API — pulls reported XBRL values for any us-gaap or company-specific concept (Revenue, ContractWithCustomerLiability, OrderBacklog, etc.) across all filings of a given CIK.
proposed_connector.rationale: Backlog is typically a non-XBRL narrative disclosure, but revenue realization in 2024-2025 from the backlog is testable via XBRL. Comparing backlog-implied 2024-2025 revenue against subsequent realized revenue is the structural test of the claim. No catalog connector currently pulls XBRL company-concept timeseries.
proposed_connector.completeness: All SEC XBRL filers (US issuers and many foreign filers)

claims.extraction_notes: Backlog is a soft, internally-defined number not directly registered anywhere. The cleanest external adjudication is whether subsequent quarterly revenue realizations are consistent with the backlog figure — which requires an XBRL timeseries connector we don't have. edgar_fts on 'Microvast' across customer CIKs would be a weak proxy since most named customers (Iveco, Kalmar, FPT Industrial, Foton, Higer, JBM, Ashok Leyland) are non-SEC-filers.
